description: This file defines interfaces for system management, discovery, configuration, lifetime notifications, and metadata within the WPEFramework's Plugin exchange namespace. It consists of multiple abstract classes with virtual methods, structured as JSON comments for serialization, and includes only interface declarations without implementations.

classes.name: ISystemManagement
classes.description: Interface for system management operations such as reboot, delete, clone, and environment query.

classes.name: IDiscovery
classes.description: Interface for network discovery, starting discovery process and retrieving discovery results.

classes.name: IConfiguration
classes.description: Interface for configuration persistence and retrieval for given callsigns.

classes.name: ILifeTime
classes.description: Interface for managing plugin lifecycle, including activation, deactivation, suspend, resume, and notifications.

classes.name: ILifeTime::INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for plugin state changes.

classes.name: IMetadata
classes.description: Interface providing metadata about proxies, status, links, process info, subsystems, version, and call stacks.

methods.name: Reboot
methods.description: Reboot the device.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Removes contents of a directory from persistent storage.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a clone of a plugin with a new callsign.

methods.name: Environment
methods.description: Provides environment variable value for a given index.

methods.name: StartDiscovery
methods.description: Starts network discovery with specified TTL.

methods.name: DiscoveryResults
methods.description: Provides SSDP network discovery results.

methods.name: Persist
methods.description: Stores configuration to persistent memory.

methods.name: Configuration (getter and setter)
methods.description: Gets or sets configuration value for specified callsign.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a plugin lifecycle notification sink.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a plugin lifecycle notification sink.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Activates a plugin by callsign.

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.description: Deactivates a plugin by callsign.

methods.name: Unavailable
methods.description: Marks a plugin as unavailable for interaction.

methods.name: Hibernate
methods.description: Sets a plugin to Hibernate state with optional timeout.

methods.name: Suspend
methods.description: Suspends a plugin.

methods.name: Resume
methods.description: Resumes a suspended plugin.

methods.name: Proxies
methods.description: Returns details about current proxies.

methods.name: Status
methods.description: Returns status and configuration details for a plugin.

methods.name: Links
methods.description: Provides active connection details.

methods.name: ProcessInfo
methods.description: Provides info about framework processes, worker pools, etc.

methods.name: Subsystems
methods.description: Provides details about active subsystems.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Provides version info of WPEFramework.

methods.name: CallStack
methods.description: Provides call stack info for a thread index.
